start.text: Welcome to the General Store. Trade's slow with the roads the way they are. Buying or just looking?

stock.text: Bandages, canned goods, a knife or two. Nothing fancy. Come back when I've got the counter open — trading's not wired up yet.

supply.text: Meridian caravans, mostly. Corporate types. They pay well and ask too many questions. I don't trust them, but I take their crates.
